content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Shivaji University, Kolhapur, dated 2 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SUK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SUK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for S.R.P.D. Coordinator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SUK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pariksha Bhavan 1, Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on the date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 1000 per day.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum graduate with computer knowledge; 3 years' experience of work related to a university computer system; experience on a university examination-related computer system preferred.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Computer knowledge is required.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview at Pariksha Bhavan 1, Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary engagement under the SUK SRPD project (October 2025 to September 2028). Project duration is till September 2028; the University reserves the right to close the project earlier. Services will be terminated immediately if work is unsatisfactory.
